deck.summary: Our tools invoke each other: hooks, hints and shared services fire on every session without anyone remembering.

sections.h: Five steps bring the fleet up, with one sudo

items: Create your private config repo from `examples/dotfiles/`
Add the thismoon source and run `ralph up`
Write `routes.toml` and register d-man: the one sudo

blocks.text: Set profiles **before the first `ralph up`**: a machine with none silently skips every profile-gated recipe and source, and only `ralph doctor` will say so.
